如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    柯婉晴满意的点头，搂着女儿走到餐厅，“我宝贝儿回来了，开饭开饭，上面两个臭小子还不下来就没饭吃了。”
柯婉晴姓柯，曾经是比沐家还要名望的柯家的大小姐，性格强势也有些爽利，柯家有一半是从政的，和政坛有牵扯不清的关系，这也是前世为什么柯婉晴他们宁愿让强奸犯逍遥也不愿意让沐如岚打官司的原因，那个市长，是柯家出来的人，他们还要靠着他得到许多东西呢，她一个不争气带不了什么利益给他们的女儿，怎么能够相比？
“妈妈今天跟爸爸去钓鱼，给我家宝贝儿钓了好多鱼，吃鱼身体好，吃不胖还营养，宝贝儿吃多点，别让自己累着了。”
柯婉晴不停的说着，沐震阳只是偶尔插插嘴，柯婉晴强势，沐震阳则因为柯婉晴娘家而弱势，再加上沐震阳从商天分确实不高，所以其实沐家势力都是柯婉晴在掌控，而沐震阳这个一家之主，也是表面上的而已，许多事，他在私底下都要问过柯婉晴才可以。
这也是上辈子沐如岚的倔强性子出来后，沐震阳对她态度越来越糟糕的原因，他都被老婆压了那么多年了，竟然连女儿都不听他的话敢跟他顶嘴，这是在挑战他的威严！把他被柯婉晴压了那么多年一直藏在心底的不爽给发泄了出来，发泄到了无辜的亲生女儿身上。
前世许多看不明白的事，今生反而一目了然了，是因为她成了变态了的缘故么？
沐如岚把鲜嫩的鱼肉夹进口中，嘴角浅淡的笑容温暖柔和。
边上传来动静，沐如岚侧头，看到是沐如霖，她自然的把碗里许多被柯婉晴夹过来的鱼儿最鲜嫩的部位夹一些给沐如霖，沐如霖嘴角微不可查的勾起，镜片下，脸颊微微的泛红。
那边因为晚了一步被沐如霖抢了位置的沐如森脸色臭了臭，下一秒撅着嘴朝沐如岚撒娇，“姐，我也要！你怎么只给霖啊，你是不是不疼我了？”
“胡说，都是我弟弟，怎么能不疼？”沐如岚笑嗔了他一眼，把碗里剩下的鱼肉夹进他碗里。
柯婉晴一看，眼底有笑意，嘴上却不高兴道：“怎么回事？两个小兔崽子，干嘛抢姐姐的肉？今天还在学校打架了吧？”
“吃饭就吃饭，干嘛扯到那事上？”一提到那件事，沐如森脸色就臭了，不耐烦的顶了柯婉晴一句，低头扒饭。
“诶，你……”
“妈。”沐如岚给她夹了片她爱吃的嫩牛肉，笑容温暖柔和的道：“少年嘛，正是年少轻狂的时候，打打闹闹很正常的。”
“干嘛一副很老成的样子，明明才大一岁而已……”沐如森鼓着两腮嘀嘀咕咕的道。
沐如岚眼眸立刻带了一丝严厉，“闭嘴，老实吃饭。”
沐如森立刻闭上嘴巴乖乖的吃饭，扒了两口又顿住，漂亮的眼睛滴溜溜的看了沐如岚一眼，伸出筷子夹了片萝卜，做贼似的缓慢的伸出手，在几双眼睛之下跨过餐桌，放进沐如岚碗里，沐如岚抬眼看他，他无辜的眨两下眼睛，然后露出可爱的讨好的笑，小虎牙闪闪的，顿时叫沐如岚又是一阵宠溺无奈。
沐如霖看着这一幕，眼底不由得布上了阴霾，每一次都是这样，好不容易他能和姐姐亲密一点儿的时候，双胞胎兄弟总会冒出来坏事，理所当然的抢走姐姐所有的关注，别人的他才不在乎，反正他喜欢一个人搞点东西，可是沐如岚是他唯一一个想要分享他的一切的人，可偏偏，他的分享计划在这个跟屁虫一样的早出生一分钟的双胞胎哥哥下，无数次被扰乱！
真气人……
吃完晚餐沐如岚便上楼洗漱，她的屋子和她的人一样，给人予一种十分温暖又有几分可爱的感觉，因为她的屋里，有许多的人偶，各种各样的，基本都是可以拆分的骨节型木制人偶，各式各样的摆置在一个十分漂亮的橱窗上，甚至还有木偶奇遇记的匹诺曹呢。

沐如霖抱着书走了进来，一向显得冷清孤高的美少年一走进这个地方，周身的清冷似乎便褪去了许多，他走到橱窗面前，目光扫过上面的人偶，他不知道姐姐为什么独独钟爱人偶，不过女孩子嘛，喜欢这些东西很正常，而且沐如岚格调也符合气质上多了。

Ke Wanqing nodded with satisfaction, hugged her daughter and walked to the restaurant, "My baby is back. Let's start dinner. The two brats above won't have anything to eat until they get down."
Ke Wanqing's surname was Ke. She was once the eldest daughter of the Ke family, which was even more famous than the Mu family. She had a strong and cheerful personality. Half of the Ke family was involved in politics and had unclear connections with the political arena. This was why Ke Wanqing and the others would rather let the rapist go free than let Mu Rulan go to court in the previous life. The mayor was from the Ke family, and they had to rely on him to get a lot of things. How could she compare to a daughter who failed to live up to expectations and brought no benefits to them?
"Mom and dad went fishing today and caught a lot of fish for my baby. Fish is good for your health. It doesn't make you fat and is nutritious. Baby, please eat more and don't let yourself get tired."
Ke Wanqing kept talking, and Mu Zhenyang only interrupted occasionally. Ke Wanqing was strong, while Mu Zhenyang was weak because of Ke Wanqing's natal family. In addition, Mu Zhenyang's business talent was indeed not high, so in fact, Ke Wanqing controlled the power of the Mu family, and Mu Zhenyang, the head of the family, was only superficial. He had to ask Ke Wanqing about many things in private.
This is also the reason why Mu Zhenyang's attitude towards Mu Rulan became worse and worse after her stubborn temper emerged in the previous life. He has been suppressed by his wife for so many years, and his daughter dares not even listen to him and dares to talk back to him. This is a challenge to his majesty! He let out the unhappiness that Ke Wanqing had suppressed in his heart for so many years and vented it on his innocent biological daughter.
Many things that were incomprehensible in her previous life are now clear to her. Is it because she has become a pervert?
Mu Rulan took the fresh fish into her mouth, with a warm and gentle smile on her lips.
There was movement from the side. Mu Rulan turned her head and saw that it was Mu Rulin. She naturally took some of the most tender parts of the fish that Ke Wanqing had picked up in the bowl and gave them to Mu Rulin. The corners of Mu Rulin's mouth were slightly raised, and her cheeks were slightly red under the lenses.
Mu Rusen, who was a step too late and was snatched away by Mu Rulin, looked disgusted. The next second, he pouted and acted coquettishly at Mu Rulan, "Sister, I want it too! Why did you only give it to Lin? Do you not love me anymore?"
"Nonsense, he's my brother, how can it not hurt?" Mu Rulan smiled and gave him an angry look, then put the remaining fish in the bowl into his bowl.
When Ke Wanqing looked at it, there was a smile in her eyes, but she said unhappily: "What's going on? Why are you two little bastards trying to steal my sister's flesh? Were they fighting in school today?"
"Let's eat when we eat. Why do we get involved in that matter?" As soon as that matter was mentioned, Mu Rushen's face turned foul. He said something to Ke Wanqing impatiently and lowered his head to eat.
"Hey, you..."
"Mom." Mu Rulan gave her a piece of tender beef that she loved to eat, and said with a warm and gentle smile: "Young man, when you are young and frivolous, it is normal to have fights."
"Why do you look so mature? You're only one year older..." Mu Rushen muttered, puffing out his cheeks.
Mu Rulan's eyes immediately showed a hint of sternness, "Shut up and eat honestly."
Mu Rusen immediately closed her mouth and ate obediently. After taking two bites, she paused again. Her beautiful eyes glanced at Mu Rulan. She stretched out her chopsticks to pick up a piece of radish. She slowly stretched out her hand like a thief and looked at Mu Rulan with her beautiful eyes. Then he crossed the dining table and put it into Mu Rulan's bowl. Mu Rulan raised her eyes to look at him. He blinked twice innocently, and then showed a cute and flattering smile, with gleaming little tiger teeth. Mu Rulan suddenly felt doting and helpless.
Mu Rulin looked at this scene and couldn't help but have a haze in his eyes. It was like this every time. When he could finally get closer to his sister, the twin brothers would always do bad things and take away all the care from his sister.Note, he doesn't care about other people. Anyway, he likes to make things alone, but Mu Rulan is the only one he wants to share everything about him. However, his sharing plan has been disrupted countless times by this follower-like twin brother who was born a minute early!
So infuriating...
After dinner, Mu Rulan went upstairs to wash up. Her room, like her people, gave people a very warm and somewhat cute feeling, because there were many dolls in her room, all kinds of them, basically all detachable joint-shaped wooden dolls. They were all displayed in a very beautiful window, and there was even Pinocchio from Pinocchio.
Mu Rulin walked in with a book in his arms. As soon as the handsome young man who always seemed aloof and aloof seemed to lose a lot of his coldness when he walked into this place, he walked to the window and glanced at the dolls on it. He didn't know why his sister only loved dolls, but it was normal for girls to like these things, and Mu Rulan's style was much more in line with her temperament.
